lines.text: Runs the leaderboard refused no longer hold up your new runs, which are now sent first
Runs from before a Terror reset are dropped at once instead of waiting for days
The leaderboard's You tab counts the runs it refused apart from those waiting to be sent
Wisp Projector gives all three of its spirits at once, Oak Sage's life too, where only its Spirit of Barbs stayed
Nature's Peace's Oak Sage life now counts beside Wisp Projector or a weaker Oak Sage of your own
A Druid's own spirit and those his items raise now count together, the stronger where both give the same bonus
Item charges show the level their item names, so Nature's Peace's Oak Sage reads Level 5 with its +50% life, not Level 2
Normal, Nightmare and Hell clears by a strong hero, one Akara restarted at 99 among them, reach the leaderboard again
Terror tiers past tier 40 add +1% Magic Find a tier, down from +2%
Each hero has a second weapon set, as in Diablo II, and W swaps between them
The inventory's I and II tabs swap weapon sets, and so does a tap on the new I / II button on phones and tablets
Only the weapon set in your hands counts, so the other set gives no stats, skills or auras
A controller swaps weapons with the left stick's click, which Options, CONTROLLER can change
Options has a KEYBOARD page that shows every key and lets you rebind it, with two keys for each action
Your hero walks with the mouse and the arrow keys, and W, A, S and D no longer move, as in Diablo II
MOVE WITH WASD on the KEYBOARD page puts walking back on W, A, S and D
Every hint and hover that names a key names the one you bound
Terror tiers past tier 40 add +1% gold a tier, down from +2%
Items found past Terror tier 100 sell for no more than tier 100's
On phones and tablets the game holds its art in about a third less memory, so it crashes less at Duriel and Diablo
With Samsung Internet's dark mode on, the life and mana globes and the items' pictures are no longer drawn white
The screen no longer garbles after the display comes back from a lost graphics connection
On Windows, extracting the game files again no longer stops at the end with "D2 Survivors couldn’t save its copy of the game files"
The Dark Wanderer walks away facing where he goes, no longer sideways
In older Chrome on a scaled Windows screen, an item put down in the inventory or stash lands under the cursor again
On Windows, one graphics crash as the desktop app starts no longer leaves it on slower Direct3D 11 until the next update
Items in the inventory no longer show only their names for the whole session after one piece of item art fails to load
Back from Tristram or the Secret Cow Level, the items you left on Act I's floor are still there
Bul-Kathos' Sacred Charge, Famine and Naj's Circlet no longer read as not legit when moved between Diablo II's and Resurrected's files
Akara's re-draft keeps the modifier on Raise Skeleton once it has evolved into Revive, rather than freeing it every time
An evolution you banish in Akara's re-draft stays banished until your next re-draft, rather than ending at Baal
The loot filter warns in red on CHARMS when MAGIC ITEMS would sell or hide your magic charms, and KEEP on CHARMS keeps them
A runeword on a class's own base keeps that base's property, like a Paladin shield's resistances or an Amazon bow's +skills, as in Diablo II
Runewords you already own on a class's own base gain that base's property when your save loads
On phones, a pinch on the level-up cards no longer zooms the game in and leaves it zoomed after your pick
Taking off Wolfhowl or Beast ends the werewolf or werebear form, its look and its bonuses, as in Diablo II
The NEWS page scrolls smoothly again, where its long list of changes made it lag
With a gamepad, tapping Y twice to open your inventory no longer sells an item, and Y never sells the gear you wear
Call to Arms no longer makes heroes of other classes yell with the Barbarian's voice as it casts its shouts
Act I's stone crosses stand one at a time, no longer packed into overlapping clumps
On tablets held sideways, a monster's enchantments under its life bar no longer run into the run's rows at the top right
Wraith Flight, Ethereal Edge, Ghostflame and Shadow Killer say Ethereal on their item box, as they always were
Trang-Oul's Claws give their missing +25% to Poison Skill Damage, worn alone or with the set, as in Diablo II
Civerb's Cudgel gives its missing +1 Maximum Damage per character level, as in Diablo II
The Ancients hold the Arreat Summit while you're on it, as in Diablo II, rather than walking off before Rite of Passage is done
The mana globe no longer stays empty while it reads full, after a run where Energy Shield spent your mana
Skills your items cast were your own fully evolved skills, with their extra bonuses, so some items gave far more than they should
Most skills an item gives are now that skill alone at the item's level, with none of your skill modifiers or evolutions, as in Diablo II
Wisp Projector was the biggest case, as its Heart of Wolverine and Spirit of Barbs added Oak Sage's life, about +125% on any hero
If your hero leaned on such an item, expect less life or damage now, since it gives only what the item gives in Diablo II
Call to Arms' Battle Orders gives Diablo II's life at its level, and its Battle Command +1 to all skills alone
Revive, Spirit Wolf, Dire Wolf and Grizzly cast by items raise only their own monster or beast
Static Field no longer kills monsters in Normal, where it leaves them at 1 life, as in Diablo II
A hero reset at Akara or with a Token of Absolution re-drafts before the Training Ground, where it used to arrive with no skills
With STAT RANGES on, items for sale in the stores read in Korean again, with each range after its line in grey
Fire, cold and lightning damage charms no longer lower your weapon skills' damage on monsters that resist those elements
Fire Arrow's and Cold Arrow's hovers no longer show more damage before their first shot than after it
A charm right-clicked at the stash after switching heroes no longer opens the previous hero's Charms window
Dragon Flight now takes you to its target while Whirlwind from Chaos spins you, instead of Whirlwind pulling you back
When the desktop app's setup is stopped as it starts copying the game files, it says an antivirus may be the cause and what to do
One Terror tier the Ladder couldn't count no longer keeps every later run of your hero off it for good
REPORT sends a contact typed as its box shows it, like @name (X), where it refused it before
A charm moved at a vendor no longer leaves the store over the character and mercenary screens in later runs
Gheed's gamble offers normal bases and, as in Diablo II, some exceptional or elite ones, so their uniques can be gambled
Scepters, staves, wands, orbs and other classes' items are no longer gambled, as in Diablo II
Ethereal Edge, Stormshield, The Grandfather and the other indestructible items say Indestructible on their item box, as in Diablo II
On the website, one damaged backup copy no longer stops the browser from keeping new backups of your save
Potions bought from Akara now go into your belt when you continue a saved run, not only in a new run
Shieldmaidens bring each fallen Valkyrie back on the skill's next cast, where all three had to fall before any returned
The hero select no longer asks for Lord of Destruction's files when the Amazon, Sorceress, Necromancer, Paladin or Barbarian is missing
The Terror leaderboard starts over with this balance update, and your heroes keep every Terror tier they've unlocked
The Amazon's Valkyrie gives your hero +6% to all resistances at level 1, up to +40% at level 8
Defense now makes monsters' blows and arrows miss you more often the higher it is, instead of cutting their damage, as in Diablo II
Each Terror tier pays +3% Magic Find and gold up to tier 40, then +2% a tier with no cap
Each Terror tier adds +1% experience and +2% items, so deeper tiers drop more instead of less
The Sorceress finds mana potions in barrels and urns, which fill Energy Shield or go to your belt when it's full
Akara sells mana potions to the Sorceress
Monsters now drop potions now and then, a quarter as often as in Diablo II
The Discord link on the site and in the game points to the new invite
Regenerate Mana on gear refills the Sorceress's Energy Shield faster
Mana stolen per hit and mana per kill now refill the Sorceress's Energy Shield
The Assassin loses the flat ×2.7 damage bonus in Terror, and the Assassin's claws, Phoenix Strike and Shadows hit harder instead
The Assassin's Venom adds 435 poison damage to each claw and blade hit at level 5 (was 80 over 2 seconds)
The Barbarian loses the flat ×2.1 damage bonus in Terror
The Druid loses the flat ×2 damage bonus in Terror, and Fire Claws, the Druid's summons and spells hit harder instead
The Druid's Fire Claws adds 254 fire damage to each hit at level 5, more with fire skills (was half the hit's damage)
The Necromancer loses the flat ×3.2 damage bonus in Terror, and Corpse Explosion, Revive and Energy are stronger instead
The Paladin loses the flat ×1.7 damage bonus in Terror, and Might, Fanaticism, Zeal and Charge are stronger instead
The Sorceress loses the flat ×1.9 damage bonus in Terror, and Hydra, Frozen Orb and Fire Bolt are stronger instead
The Necromancer's skeletons, mages and revived monsters can rise from any corpse in the skill's range, not just nearby ones
Monster auras like Holy Shock and Conviction no longer grow past their Diablo II maximum from Terror 12 on
Monsters killed by the Necromancer's Corpse Explosion leave corpses you can explode again
Corpse Explosion's Chain option instantly explodes one of the corpses its blast leaves, for half damage
Wells left behind in the last area no longer turn into black squares
The Druid's Cyclone Armor absorbs up to 536 fire, cold and lightning damage at level 5 (was +42% resistance)
The Paladin's Vengeance and Rusthandle hit the biggest pack in range, bosses first, instead of the nearest monster
The Paladin's Vengeance and Rusthandle now add your weapon's damage to their fire, cold and lightning
Iron Skin, Shout, Defiance, Holy Shield and Werebear raise Defense, which the character screen now shows in its own box
Damage Reduced now comes only from items, Charsi, Fade and Bone Armor, up to 50%, and no longer from Battle Orders or Werewolf
Deep Terror tiers no longer make monsters' aim better than Diablo II's toughest, and they still raise monsters' life and damage
Resurrecting clears monster missiles already in the air, so they can't kill your hero again right away
Resurrecting removes poison, curses, chill and freeze from your hero
Conviction from items reaches 2.5 times farther, on your hero or your mercenary
Holy Fire, Holy Freeze and Holy Shock from items reach as far as the Paladin's own auras
Monsters attack whatever is closest, your hero, your mercenary or your summons, Valkyrie and Decoy included
Summons' life now grows with the Terror tier, about 3 times at tier 30 and 12 times at tier 100
The Necromancer's Bone Armor absorbs all physical damage until it breaks (was half of each hit)
The Assassin's Shadow Warrior and Shadow Master have 55,819 life at level 99 (was 455 and 700)
The Assassin's Fade makes curses on your hero last 82% less at level 5
The Amazon's Inner Sight reaches 1.7 times farther
The Paladin's Conviction reaches 2.2 times farther at level 5
The Paladin's Holy Fire, Holy Freeze and Holy Shock reach 3 to 3.8 times farther at level 5
The Rogue Scout mercenary's Inner Sight reaches 1.7 times farther
The Desert Mercenary's Holy Freeze reaches as far as the Paladin's
The Barbarian's Increased Stamina regenerates 1% of max life per second at level 5 (was +61% max life)
Max Stamina and Heal Stamina on items and charms now regenerate life (they did nothing before)
Terror tiers 4 to 39 pay less Magic Find and gold than before, since the pay now climbs all the way up
The Assassin's Claw Mastery gives +111% damage at level 5 (was +60%)
The Druid's Twister gets +100% damage from each of Tornado and Hurricane (was +5%)
The Druid's Firestorm gets +230% damage from Molten Boulder (was +12%)
+8 skills from items make the Druid's Fissure 3.9 times stronger (was 1.8 times)
The Necromancer's Iron Maiden returns 675% of melee damage at level 8 (was 275%)
The Necromancer's Iron Golem returns 435% of melee damage (was 200%)
The Necromancer's revived monsters hit as hard as that monster would hit your hero
The Necromancer's Teeth gets +150% damage from each of Bone Spear and Bone Spirit (was +8%)
The Paladin's Sacrifice attacks every 0.6 seconds, as fast as a normal attack (was once a second at level 8)
The Sorceress's Fire Bolt gets +160% damage from each of Fire Ball and Meteor (was +8%)
Zakarum priests and Fallen Shamans also target your nearest summon or mercenary
+12 skills from items make the finishing blow of Claws of Thunder and Blades of Ice 2 to 3 times stronger
Phoenix Strike's meteor, lightning and ice charges each get only their own synergy, +100% to +130%
The Druid's wolves, Grizzly, ravens and vines gain 1% damage per point of Energy, like the Druid's spells
The Sorceress's Hydra recharges in 1.6 seconds at level 8 (was 4.2)
Each of the Sorceress's Hydras lasts 10 seconds at every level, so up to six can be out at once
The Sorceress's Frozen Orb shards fly nearly twice as far
The Necromancer's golems hit 1.4 to 1.8 times harder in Hell and Terror
The Necromancer's Corpse Explosion deals 70% to 120% of the corpse's life (was 36 + 46%)
The Necromancer's Corpse Explosion reaches 2.5 times farther
The Necromancer's Corpse Explosion deals less from corpses of monsters above your hero's level
The Sorceress's Energy Shield still uses at most 400 mana per hit
The Paladin's Might gives +230% damage at level 5 (was +115%)
The Paladin's Fanaticism gives +373% damage at level 5 (was +187%)
The Paladin's Concentration gives +345% damage at level 5 (was +173%)
The Paladin's Zeal deals 44 damage at level 8 (was 29)
The Paladin's Zeal hits 4 times at level 1 and 5 times from level 2 (was 2, rising to 6)
The Paladin's Zeal gets +15% damage per level of Sacrifice (was +6%)
The Paladin's Charge deals 152 damage at level 8 (was 83)
The Paladin's Herald of Zakarum deals 110 damage (was 60)
The Paladin's Holy Bolt gets +500% from Fist of the Heavens and +63% per level of Blessed Hammer (was +25%)
The Paladin's Vengeance adds 41 fire, 41 cold and 41 lightning damage at level 8 (was 29 each)
The Necromancer's revived monsters have their full life and damage again (was half)
The Assassin's Fists of Fire, Claws of Thunder and Blades of Ice hit 1.5 times harder, like Phoenix Strike
The Assassin's Shadow Warrior and Shadow Master gain 1% damage per point of Energy, like the Assassin's spells
The Ladder refuses runs from heroes holding more of Charsi's ranks than play could pay for, every ware counted
Each point of the Necromancer's Energy adds 1.5% spell damage (was 1%)
Each point of Energy still adds 1% spell damage for every other class
The Assassin's traps now fire all their shots, instead of a new trap often replacing one that had barely fired
Laying Death Sentry no longer removes the Assassin's Lightning Sentries
The Necromancer's Poison Nova reaches a third farther
Monsters immune to chill and freeze in Diablo II, like Hell's wraiths, are immune here too once you extract the Monsters part again
Chill slows monsters by half on Normal and by a third or a quarter in Hell, as in Diablo II
Spirit of Barbs from item charges, like Wisp Projector's, returns 110% of melee damage to the attacker only
The Necromancer's Iron Maiden no longer gets stronger from Energy or magic damage on gear
Heroes restarted from level 99 wear their golden glow round the campfire too
Runewords land with Diablo II's rune drop sound
Braziers and torches light the floor around them, and shrines light up as you use them
Unique monsters carry a light around them, and so do a few others like Fallen Shamans
Each area has its own light, darker in Act IV's City of the Damned and in dungeons like the Catacombs, as in Diablo II
Rain falls over Act I and Act III and snow over Act V, in storms that come and go as in Diablo II
Rain is heard as it falls, louder as a storm builds
VIDEO OPTIONS has a WEATHER switch that turns the rain and snow off
The wilds of Acts I, II and V lie on one ground with Diablo II's own puddles, tree stands, stones and dunes
Diablo II's dirt paths wind across Act I's wilds and the Secret Cow Level, joining the camps and cottages
The outdoors turn through Diablo II's day and night, a white day, a mauve dusk, a blue night and an orange dawn, 25 minutes a day
Nights are lighter than Diablo II's so a horde stays in sight, and dungeons, Act IV and the camp keep their own light
Worldstone Shards stand out in a crowded fight under a beam of silver light, with Diablo II's gleam twinkling on them
Ctrl-click a stat's + to spend 5 stat points at once, or press X on it with a controller
Monsters, missiles and objects are heard from where they are, from the left or the right and fainter farther off, as in Diablo II
Monsters call out now and then as they start to walk, and swarms hum as they come near, as in Diablo II
Braziers and torches crackle as you pass them
A Fallen screams as it flees
Each area plays its own Diablo II music, from the Catacombs and the Tomb to Kurast and the Worldstone Keep
The outdoors sound of night from dusk to dawn, with Diablo II's crickets and howls
Your hero's footsteps are heard as in Diablo II, on dirt, stone, sand, snow or wood, heavier for the Barbarian
Monsters flash with the fire, cold or lightning of the blow that makes them flinch or kills them, as in Diablo II
Monsters standing in a fire burn, and a Crushing Blow or thorns shows on the monster it strikes
Monsters bleed as they're hit, some green, and skeletons and ghosts not at all, as in Diablo II
One in five monsters that die chilled or frozen shatters into ice, and Cold Enchanted uniques always do, as in Diablo II
A shattered monster's corpse is still there for corpse skills, though no body is drawn
Undead Fetishes fall to bones, Doom Knights burn, frog demons burst and vultures shed feathers as they die, as in Diablo II
A Fetish Shaman leaves a Fetish's body as it dies, as in Diablo II
A pack's drops lie apart round the bodies, never on scenery or each other, so their names no longer pile up, as in Diablo II
Diablo II's camps, cottages and ruins stand with their own torches, fires, chests and urns, and Act V's swinging heads
The Cairn Stones rise on Diablo II's own stone circle
Cocoons and evil urns let four small spiders loose as you kick them open, as in Diablo II
Chests lie on the field in Acts I, II, III and V at Diablo II's chances, kicked open as you walk into them
Wells stand in Act III's jungle and Kurast and Act V's wilds, giving back half your life and mana and curing poison and curses
Hurricane is drawn as in Diablo II, a thick storm of wind, rocks and branches circling the Druid
Trees and rocks in the wilds block the way as in Diablo II, with a way always left through the Dark Wood
A runeword never drops with only its runes' lines, and one that did gets its own back
Bows, crossbows and Phase Blades are never ethereal, as in Diablo II
Closing the blacksmith's window by the act's red portal no longer sends you through it a second later
In a big fight the nearest monsters and your own sounds keep their voices, where the newest sounds used to be cut whatever they were
A run's page on the website shows your hero's Charsi ranks of Magic Find and Gold Find
Attract's Lure raises its totem by a pack a little way off, no longer by the monster beside you, so it draws the pack away from you
Right-clicking a charm into the Charms window opens it, so the charm no longer seems to vanish
A Barbarian with a dagger or a javelin in either hand is drawn holding it, not a hand axe, once the next update re-extracts your game files
Turning down Skill Effects in Video Options no longer fades your hero's golden glow
A run you start on Nightmare or Hell with your kept hero starts its clock at 0:00, not at all the time your hero has played
In the camp and in an item's preview, the character screen and skill hovers count gear's auras, Dream's Holy Shock among them
Flat fire, cold and lightning damage on charms and gear no longer lowers a critical-strike build's damage
Kashya's and Akara's menus stay on the screen, so a long hire list no longer hides the Rogue Scout past its top
The loot filter's BETTER ONLY picks up a second copy whose chance to cast or charges roll a higher skill level
The skill icons at the top left no longer run under the timer when your mercenary and several summons are out
Starting Nightmare anew after Akara's re-draft no longer asks you to fill Hell's 10 skill and 10 passive slots
With 8 skill slots, your slots beside the skill tree no longer cover its bottom-left skills and their modifiers
Hardcore Terror runs in gear a fallen hero found no longer show as unverified on the ladder
Reduces all Vendor Prices on worn gear, Edge's among it, now takes its share off Charsi's and Gheed's prices
On the Ladder's Find tab, the count under the players found or a player's runs matches the rows on the page
Each heal a High Council member gives himself is half the last, so one who runs off to heal can always be worn down
Gear's +N to a skill gives N levels on every class, so Trang-Oul's +18 Fire Ball is level 18 instead of 1
Items for any class no longer hold your own class's skill to +3, so Dragonscale's +10 Hydra gives a Sorceress 10
Spells your gear casts grow with their levels as your own do, faster for casters than for a Barbarian, Amazon or Paladin
Attack skills from gear, like Chaos's Whirlwind, hit as hard as the same levels learned, no longer harder
The leaderboard no longer refuses a run whose Magic Find or Gold Find reads higher than your Charsi ranks and gear explain
The stash's Collect button sits in one gold frame instead of over three empty sockets
A run on the Ladder shows its mercenary's Charsi wares rounded, as the game does, not with long decimals
Knockback stops what a monster was doing as it pushes it back
Knockback pushes monsters farther sideways and less far up or down the screen
Knockback pushes small monsters like Fallen on every hit, and never moves Izual, the Ancients or nests, as in Diablo II
A Hardcore run's start that can't reach the leaderboard is sent again once it can, and no longer leaves the hero unranked
A resistance's hover on the character screen shows how far it goes past its cap, and your Absorb of that element
Once your Terror tiers are open, the waypoint's Act V tab has a Training Ground, with dummies that never attack, to measure your damage
In the Training Ground, Larzuk sets 1 to 50 dummies or a boss, changes what they're immune to, and opens your stash to try other gear
Gear's +N to one of your class's skills gives you that skill even before you learn it, as in Diablo II
The skills your gear casts, like Enigma's Teleport, show in a row under your passives, and a right-click rests one as it rests your own
The desktop app no longer stops at the Items step while setting up some Diablo II copies
Akara's re-draft offers +1 to your skill trees again, drawn like any other card, so the tree levels your hero had can go back on the trees
A Barbarian's Increased Stamina adds its share of a Vitality pick right away, so his life no longer changes after a reload
A run the leaderboard refuses is sent again for two days, so a wrong refusal no longer loses it
Monsters your mercenary kills drop items with your Magic Find added to his, as in Diablo II, and favour your class's items
Wolfhowl and other gear with Werewolf or Werebear keep your hero in that form, where it turned back at once
Teleport from gear (Enigma's) blinks every hero but the Sorceress into the pack nearby, no longer away from the monsters she fights
On a phone, the stash's Collect button now asks first, and only a second tap puts the items in
After Collect, the Uniques tab opens on what went in, so the shared tabs it emptied no longer look like lost items
Standing still anywhere in a red portal takes your hero through after a second, where only its very foot counted
Walking into a red portal and out again tells you once how to go through
With a weapon in each hand, the other weapon's leech, crushing blow and deadly strike no longer add to every blow, as in Diablo II
With a weapon in each hand, each weapon's attack speed counts at half
Whirlwind with a weapon in each hand now strikes with both on every hit
On a phone a Stash or Inventory button moves the item in your hand across in one tap, with the stash open
Until you first take the camp's waypoint, it pulses under an arrow, and a trail on the ground and an arrow at the screen's edge lead to it
The stash's Collect button puts every unique, set item and runeword your collection lacks into the Uniques tab, from any tab
A kept card on the Uniques tab offers a Swap when a better roll of it lies in your inventory or stash, both boxes side by side
Typing unique, set, runeword, rare or magic in the stash's searches finds the items of that rarity
The skill tree marks each skill you banished with a red X, and its hover says it's banished for this hero
The wiki has a Runewords page with every runeword, its runes and properties, and how runewords drop
The desktop app finishes extracting Diablo II: Resurrected on a PC short of memory, where its extractor ran out and stopped part way
The desktop app says so when you pick a Diablo III or IV folder, and asks for Diablo II's, where it stopped with the wrong advice
The desktop app says plainly when Diablo II: Resurrected is still updating in Battle.net, or the drive it's on can't be read
The desktop app extracts a Diablo II: Resurrected install whose Battle.net files don't name their build, where setup stopped at once
Under a Holy Freeze with Cannot Be Frozen your hero no longer turns blue, and the slow's hover says it's an aura's, not a freeze
The AUTO STATS hint in Options says it spends 3 points on damage for each on Vitality
On a phone the sound and music play with its ring/silent switch on silent, as a video's do
Sound the phone stops mid-run comes back on your next tap, key or controller press, where a phone stayed silent entering Tristram
Level-up cards fade in and take no tap, click or press for their first 1.2 seconds, so a tap meant for the run no longer picks one
A Terror tier's boss no longer waits forever on a last wave whose monsters can't come in
In a Terror tier's last wave a monster that stays out of sight, running or keeping its distance, is brought into view
Without your graphics card in use, Options says to turn on graphics acceleration in Chrome or Edge, where it said to update the driver
Every piece of a set drops by its own rarity, so Tal Rasha's armor no longer comes far more often than her helm, belt or orb
On a small phone held upright the skill tree stands above your skill slots, so its third tab and a Book of Skill work again
On a phone held sideways the LOOT FILTER's lines stand in two columns, larger to tap and clear of the control panel
On a phone held upright a Terror tier's affixes step aside while an elite's bar shows, so the bar no longer covers the field
A red portal takes you only when you click or tap it, use the pad's interact, or stand in it a second as its ring fills
On a slow connection an act's monster and hero art no longer fails to load as the act starts, and what fails is asked for again
Monsters whose art can't load come as stand-ins rather than not at all, so the waves and the act boss still arrive
A second copy's box now says "You have kept one already", so it's never mistaken for the kept one headed "In your collection"
On a phone a tap on the belt drinks while another finger steers, where it drank only with the hero standing still
Enchant from gear such as Lava Gout adds its fire to any class's attacks, and Venom from gear its poison, as in Diablo II
A mercenary's Medusa's Gaze curses the monster that strikes him with Lower Resist, and his gear's Enchant and Venom go on his blows
An evolution you banish in Akara's re-draft stays banished until your next Baal, so no chest evolves that skill anyway
Dragon Flight's kick explodes in Dragon Tail's fire around what it kicks, where it dealt far less than the Dragon Tail it evolves from
The HUD's labels and the menus' words come back with a display that went black, where they stayed blank
A run whose display came back after going black waits for your tap to go on, where it sat paused with no menu or no sound
While the display is lost, the black screen says it's waiting for the display to come back
A runeword drops on any base it fits, each as likely, where a few strong bases took most of them and early Hell had one or two for each
High runewords such as Enigma and Call to Arms drop only on bases near the best of their kind, and low ones on any base
A mercenary's Treachery casts Fade on him, as in Diablo II, and his gear's Bone Armor, Cyclone Armor and Slow Missiles work too
The Refilling Shrine fills your mana as well as your life, as in Diablo II, so Energy Shield's mana too
If the browser can't start the sound at your first key or click, the next one tries again, where it stayed silent until a reload
Runewords drop again when the game runs on Diablo II: Resurrected's files, and the Uniques tab pictures each on its own base
Fortitude gives 1 to 1.5 Life per level and Leaf 2 Defense per level, where both gave none, and ones you've found are fixed
Griswold's Valor absorbs cold damage based on your level instead of none
Items in the stash and shops outside the camp read their per-level lines at your hero's level instead of level 1
A caster's skill learned again beside its own evolutions gains their synergies, as Poison Dagger from Poison Explosion and Poison Nova
Famine's Enhanced Damage range reads 320-370% with stat ranges shown, where it left out Ohm's 50%
In a run the inventory's gold box counts the run's gold too, so picked up gold and the LOOT FILTER's sales show there at once
A Full Rejuvenation Potion restores all your mana as well as your life, as in Diablo II, so Energy Shield's mana too
Runewords drop already made, all 78 of Diablo II's, with no runes, sockets or white bases to gather
Each comes on a base of its kind with the sockets its runes need, the good bases most often, and now and then ethereal
The top runes' runewords, Enigma, Grief and Infinity among them, drop only in Terror
The stash's Uniques tab keeps one of each runeword on a rune stone of its own
Gear that gives another class's skill, like Enigma's Teleport, now casts it at a level your +all skills raise
Meteor falls on the thickest packs in reach instead of on random monsters
Phoenix Strike's blow and its meteor, lightning and ice deal 50% more damage
